extracted.intended_audience: graduate students applying to the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (Science & Engineering Track)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and deadlines for applicants to the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (Science and Engineering Track), intended for Ph.D. students whose work advances high-performance computing applications to complex science and engineering problems. Includes eligibility intent, submission deadlines, and rules for supporting materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target applicant eligibility (Science and Engineering Track)
rubrics_metrics.description: This application is intended for graduate students pursuing a Ph.D. in fields of study that advance the use of high-performance computing (HPC) to solve specific, complex science and engineering problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be Ph.D. students whose proposed research explicitly advances HPC applications to concrete science or engineering problems; the track is not for unrelated graduate study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The deadline for online submission was January 15, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowship offers will be extended by mid-April. All applicants with a complete final submission will, in that same period, receive an email regarding the outcome of their application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of recommendation deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of recommendation are due by January 22, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the official due date for letters is January 22, the program indicates flexibility for references if delays are outside the applicant's control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official transcripts deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Official transcripts are due by January 31, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site explicitly states that transcripts will be accepted after the January 15 online-submission deadline; however, official transcripts must arrive by January 31.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental materials deadline constraint
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of supplemental materials should not exceed the below deadline dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must ensure any supplemental documents conform to the stated post-submission cutoff dates (e.g., letters and official transcripts dates above); unspecified supplemental items should not be submitted past those deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status checking of supporting materials
rubrics_metrics.description: You can still log in to check on the status of your supporting materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants have ongoing online access to monitor whether letters, transcripts, and other supporting documents have been received.
